folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B382: exact variant slice versus all-source horizon
folds.body:
This entire checkpoint, including later Crab/Frog/quota evidence and ownership release, was read. It delivers one native ingredient-contribution consumer, not the all-source request. Goat4, Crab10 and Frog10 versus Boar3 are original gameplay quantities; functional contribution changes paid amount without asserting canon identity, nutritional truth, potency or symbolic equivalence. The learned method, encountered-source knowledge, exact selected species, native spender, Animal fat output and real downstream balm use retain distinct owners. A nine-unit Frog refusal cannot silently fall back to Goat/Boar. The forced quota case preserves prior stock/output before retry.

The low-skill downstream Alchemy failure was addressed by an explicit ordinary-competence fixture, not a granted result. The broad Cooking/experiment selector failure was corrected in the driver. Keep such failed probes and exact rebuilt/persistence input limits separate from product defects. All three chosen variants have their attributed native receipts; the3029-pass/one-failure shared suite remains a failing historical run, and an unlanded other-branch export fix is not proof of combined primary closure. A catalogue header-only difference is not a changed material dataset or a current all-source validation.

The427 source paths and6282 repeating table locators are discovery, not6282 unique missing mechanics or semantic dispositions. The existing D5/G1 and topic owners retain the wider horizon; this reconciliation's actual-content ledger advances reading without pretending to implement every fitting mechanism. Original “everything” and later scoped handoffs do not renew runtime writes here, and historical active-worker/port/PID/reservation claims are not current ownership or live process evidence. AD42 keeps human review optional. No source game, private result, runtime, app adoption or all-source implementation was freshly verified.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B382: identity, source effects and remaining GX8 scope
folds.body:
The full checkpoint through its release boundary was read. Preserve one worked-item identity, condition and process history across native key rewrites, transfers and component changes. Quotes remain read-only; actual custody and stock are rechecked before transaction/save. Compatible material and degraded returns conserve the chosen spent source, while maker snapshot, workmanship, part-lot grade, condition, recognition and actual hidden material truth remain different. A shared property name does not make tools, vessels, foci and armor use one product resolver.

GX3–GX7 keep real downstream obligations: trade/gift/loadout cannot strip complete history; knowledge-based buyer appraisal does not reveal hidden metadata; heat grade, fuel quantity, duration and useful output stay separate; cooling/aging belongs to an actual clock. Conduction, insulation and power-lifetime fields require an energy/exposure/effect/removal consumer before they count as behavior. Split/merge lineage and provenance alone implement neither corrosion/fermentation nor deterioration for every product. GX8, CRL44's conditional salvage and CRL24/25's spatial landing remain explicitly unfinished, without blocking the distinct delivered native gear slice.

The old2417 full suite predates final reforge/component/NPC/display changes; current-input16 focused and gear11/lineage6 browser receipts have their stated narrower scopes. Real trade/equip/work/persistence actions use labelled material, skill, armor and damage prerequisites, not naturally acquired campaign progress. Resource404s are not zero console errors, local-font symlink is excluded from release, and a duplicate supplied G3 hunk must not be applied twice. Old merged-release authorization, ceilings and delegated reservations remain historical; no new integration or source/gameplay proof is claimed here. AD42 keeps human taste feedback optional, while combined current master and installed-app evidence remain distinct.
